question: The 12th edition of the Global Terrorism Report Index (GTI) 2025 was published by _____.

options.text: The United Nations Office to Counter Terrorism
The Institute of Economic and Peace
The United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Institute of Economic and Peace**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Global Terrorism Index (GTI)** is published annually by the **Institute for Economics and Peace (IEP)**, which is an independent, non-partisan, and non-profit think tank.
 
• The GTI provides a comprehensive summary of global trends and patterns in terrorism, analyzing its **impact on countries and their citizens**.
 
• The IEP, headquartered in **Sydney, Australia**, focuses on promoting peace through data-driven research and analysis.
 
• The GTI is based on data sourced from the **Global Terrorism Database (GTD)**, maintained by the **National Consortium for the Study of Terrorism and Responses to Terrorism (START)** at the University of Maryland.
 
• The 12th edition of the GTI in **2025** will continue to assess terrorism trends, measuring its economic impact, and providing insights into the drivers of terrorism globally.
